name: Nam Yung
source: A 20 year old girl who is also Ryo’s older sister. She loves the arts, especially painting which she is quite talented at. Nam is foul mouthed and very opinionated. She is somewhat selfish, she loves her brother, though in the end, she only looks out for herself. Along with that, she is a very lonely girl who will do absolutely anything to find a companion who cares for her, even if that means abandoning her brother.
